notes: Independently audited all 14 discovery/diamond candidates against current official pages: ten verified_free routes (six subscription and four diamond), four needs_verification routes. No route depends on a selective waiver, membership discount or institutional agreement.

All fee patches replace complete route objects and retain the original route model/OA distinction and accurate primary evidence. Optional paid OA, requested print color, offprints and elective services are separate from mandatory standard-route payment.

The two Springer journals explicitly offer subscription publication without APCs, but neither inspected journal policy expressly settled submission fees and complete mandatory publication/page/overlength costs. Both remain needs_verification; publication_fee is unknown for full cost coverage, not charged. Publisher support expressly warns of some subscription journals having page/overlength charges.

ScienceDirect author and insights policies for both Elsevier candidates remained HTTP 403; direct HTTPS also failed for insights. Readable publisher shops establish reader subscription offerings only. No author-fee conclusions were inferred from these shops or third-party lists.

PAHO official About and author-instructions pages returned HTTP 200 to ordinary direct HTTPS despite web-tool 403. Their full HTML was inspected. Broad no-fees-for-researchers language establishes the route, rather than a no-APC-only statement.

Q Bulletin is restricted to qualifying completed QA/QI projects within five years with at least two cycles. WHO guidelines contain a limited preprint exception for research during a public health emergency of international concern; a general preprint-to-journal pairing is not established.

Article limits are requirements, not assurances that authors may pay to exceed them. For routes with explicit blanket author-fee exclusions, no separate compulsory page/membership/registration cost was found. No venue was contacted and no manuscript was submitted.

Fee audit is an independent agent policy review, not human scientific review, manuscript-specific fit assessment, a guarantee of acceptance, or confirmation of eventual charges at submission. Recheck live policies before submitting.
